chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 158 — Li Huowang Rejects the Peng Zhi Illusion
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang is told he is the delusion demon Peng Zhi. In a stunning act of defiance, he kills the accuser and rejects all logic to affirm his own identity.
og_title: Li Huowang Declares: "I Don't Need a Reason to Be Me"
og_description: The Zuowandao's greatest trap crumbles against pure existential will. Li Huowang chooses himself, even against all evidence.
twitter_title: "I am Li Huowang!" — The most important scream in the novel.
twitter_description: A chapter about choosing who you are, even when the universe tells you you're a lie.
